title: Fix the List Append
description: The program should add a new item to the end of a list. Fix the bug.
actualProblem: Python lists do not have an add() method — that method belongs to sets. Calling fruits.add() raises an AttributeError.
explanation: Lists use append() to add a single item to the end. add() is the equivalent method for sets, and mixing up the two is a common beginner mistake because both represent 'adding an element'.
